test.author: Christoph Deppisch
test.name: EchoActionIT
test.description:
The example describes how to use the EchoAction to print messages to the console/logger. This function can be useful when debugging test cases.
The parent service bean is called "echo" and provides a property called "message" to declare the message to be printed. The EchoAction also provides a default message that will contain the actual data and time. More common use will be to print out variables and their content, as shown in the last EchoAction in this example.
